description: A set of key and value pairs, written as `key: value` lines at the same indentation.
An ordered list whose items each start with a dash and a space.
The parser choice of a type for a plain value from its shape, so `true`, `20` and `null` are not text.
A multi-line text value, literal with a pipe to keep line breaks or folded with a greater-than sign to join them.
A name given to a block with an ampersand and a reference to it with an asterisk, used to reuse content.
The older rule that reads yes, no, on and off as booleans, which YAML 1.2 no longer does.
A key that appears twice in one mapping, which many parsers accept while silently keeping only the last value.
